products.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Tiny
products.summary: 4MiB Flash / 2MiB PSRAM。精确SKU数字外设子集。

sources.title: Official exact SKU/options and manufacturer product description

limitations: No exact factory image found. Generic MicroPython4MB package is not a factory identity and is not substituted for N8R8.
Partial source-bounded digital simulation. Physical hardware, complete original factory applications and browser/WebGL acceptance are not claimed.
Tiny FH4R2 4F2P and PICO1-N8R8 8F8P kept separate. GPIO38 RGB; bare boards have no physical USB/BOOT/RESET. Adapter kits expose BOOT0.
RGB wire GRB follows the vendor documented Arduino2.0.11 neopixelWrite implementation; outdated example GPIO14 and generic ZeroGPIO21 are rejected using exact schematicGPIO38.
No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
No board-level layout/CAD is supplied by the inspected exact-family sources. Photo-visible component envelopes remain approximate; unknown PCB surfaces are explicitly marked UNKNOWN.
Assembly groups preserve soldered or fixed components with their carrier; kit contents without a documented mounted pose use an explicitly staged inspection layout, not a physical installation claim.
Main18x23.5mm board has no USB or physical BOOT/RESET keys. Those belong only to included18x18mm adapter kit. Exact FPC cable shape/length is not reconstructed.
Castellated edge plating and rounded notches remain simplified in this through-hole board envelope; hole centers follow2.54mm pitch with approximate bores.
N8R8 uses its own larger SiP envelope and source photo; the old FH4R2 top texture is not applied to it. N8R8 unknown faces remain explicitly blank/labeled.

chronology.notes: 硬件发布日期未知；没有把资料/固件日期当作发布时间。
